lines.t:
A special {{effect}} each <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> has that only activates
when it is chosen as <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c> in a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>.

Many are powerful effects that reach the whole
allied or opposing team.

If you set 3 <c:ffff00>{{medalia}}<c> of the same shape in the
<c:ffff00>{{medalia}} slots<c>, the {{medal}}'s {{leader_effect}} changes.
